name: CEG The Heights
address: 30 Staniforth Street, Birmingham B4 7DR, United Kingdom
about:
The Heights Birmingham is a popular student accommodation in Birmingham that offers en-suites for a balanced student life. Located at 30 Staniforth Street, B4 7DR, The Heights is convenient for students attending Aston University (10 min walk) and Birmingham City University City Centre Campus (15 min bus). Just next to prime institutions in the historic Gun Quarter (2 min), The Heights Birmingham brings out the best in the heart of the city.
 
Features
CEG The Heights provides en-suite rooms that are grouped into flats of between 4-6 occupants. Every room is furnished with essentials and comes with a private bathroom. You will share a well-equipped kitchen, dining area, and lounge with fellow residents. Booking for 16 weeks is also available now!
 
An all-inclusive experience is provided at The Heights Birmingham. Apart from your utility bills, free WiFi and access to communal amenities are also included. Workout to stay healthy at the on-site gym, finish uni work at the study area, or chat with your flatmates at the social spaces or the courtyard. On-site laundry is also provided for you to save time and effort to keep clean.
 
Location and What's Hot?
Located in the heat of the city, The Heights Birmingham is just on the upper tip of Aston University in the historic Gun Quarter. Tesco Express and E plus supermarket is just a 3-minute walk for you to get daily necessities. Finding a place to eat nearby is also easy without taking much effort. BRGRI Birmingham is right downstairs, and more options like african restaurant, Rio's Piri Piri, The Restaurant / Conference Aston are a short walk within 10 minutes. 
 
Around The Heights Birmingham, several popular bars provide a good chance for you to experience the nightlife, such as Sacks Of Potatoes, The Gosta Green, and The Bull. Your health is also paramount, and the Whittall Street Clinic is only a 6-minute walk from your home at The Heights.
 
Transportation
Students living at The Heights Birmingham will enjoy smooth and convenient travel options to everywhere you want to go. The University College Birmingham (16 min) and the University of Birmingham (30 min) are also easy to reach by bus. Aston University bus stop is at your doorstep, ready to connect you with other parts of the city. You can also choose to walk for 10 minutes to take a tram at St Chad's for further travel. Long-distance or International travel is also convenient since the Birmingham airport is only 45 minutes by public transport.
 
Security & Services
CEG The Heights Birmingham has security on-site overnight and on weekends in addition to 24-hour CCTV, and reception is open Monday to Friday (8am to 7pm) to ensure a safe environment and offer timely help.

name: Staniforth House
address: Staniforth Street, Birmingham B4 7DN, United Kingdom
about:
Unite Students - Staniforth House is a popular student accommodation in Birmingham that enjoys a prime location close to universities and the city centre. Located at Staniforth Street, B4 7DN, Staniforth House is only a 5-minute walk from both Aston University and Birmingham City University campuses. The Birmingham City Centre is also a 10-minute walk, putting you at the heart of the city with the best amenities the city has to offer. There are also two train stations within about a 10-minute walk, perfect for travelling to nearby cities. At Staniforth House, you will enjoy excellent communal facilities, including a cinema room, study spaces, a common room with a free pool and foosball, a courtyard outside for barbecues, and panoramic views of the city in the rooftop garden. Book your perfect home for 2025/26, and enjoy your best student life at Staniforth House Birmingham. *Please Note: During the 2025/26 academic year, Unite Students - Staniforth House will carry out building works between 8 am to 6 pm, Monday to Friday. You will hear noise during working hours and experience reduced light levels at times. The property will communicate notice before starting and update the process. What does Staniforth House offer?Unite Students Staniforth House is home to 586 students and offers contemporary living in the heart of the UK's second city. Both en-suites (Premium, Classic) and studios (Classic Accessible, Classic) are available for different lifestyles.En-suite is the most common type of room at Staniforth House, offering private bathrooms to ensure privacy. 5-7 students share the kitchen and living room. A 3/4 bed, a wardrobe, a desk, and a chair are common in the room. There is also a shared large lounge and kitchen area.Studio rooms are more suitable for students who prefer an independent living experience. They include a private bedroom, kitchen, and bathroom, providing a separate living space. Rooms and kitchens are fully furnished so that you can move in directly. What really sets Staniforth House apart is its exceptional communal facilities where students can relax, study, and feel in a community. There is a spacious common room with a free pool and foosball, comfy sofas to compete and chat with flatmates, a cinema room to enjoy the latest series, and a dedicated study space for students to focus on uni work. If you want to go outside to have a breath of the fresh air, head to the courtyard with picnic tables, deck chairs and ping pong, or enjoy panoramic views of the city from the rooftop garden. For your daily convenience, there will be laundry, bike storage, vending machine, recycling, and printing (extra charge) at Unite Students Staniforth House. All living essentials are free, which means there will be no extra charge for utilities (heating, water, gas, electric), WiFi, broadband, and Unite Students apps. Enjoy the all-inclusive service and make the most of your student life here. At Staniforth House Birminghan, resident safety is paramount. This commitment is upheld through comprehensive measures, including 24/7 CCTV surveillance, secure entry systems, and a dedicated on-site team providing reception services, maintenance support, and immediate assistance. The property further prioritises safety with a robust fire detection system and offers peace of mind through inclusive contents insurance for all residents.  What's nearby Unite Students Staniforth House?Staniforth House is located in the heart of Birmingham, with a 10-minute walk to the City Centre, near popular shopping centres, bars, and supermarkets. Tesco Express is a 3-minute walk from the accommodation if you need to buy snacks or groceries. As for dining options, BRGRI Birmingham (1 min walk), an african restaurant(4 min walk), Rio's Piri Piri (7 min walk), The Chicken Hut (8 min walk), and more will offer you diverse choices without travelling far. Want to have a taste of the Brum nightlife? The Bull, Gunmakers Arms, Unity Pub, Sacks of Potatoes, and more are about a 10-minute walk from Staniforth House Birmingham so you do not have to worry about how to get home. To experience more, head to popular landmarks like Thinktank Birmingham Science Museum (16 min walk), Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery (21 min walk), and Bullring & Grand Central (22 min walk) is also a short walk.
 How to get around Staniforth House Birmingham?Staniforth House stands out as an ideal student accommodation, strategically positioned within walking distance or a short bus/tram ride to key universities like BCU, Aston, and UoB – putting lectures, libraries, and campus life just minutes away. Both Aston University and BCU City Centre Campus are just a 5-minute walk, the University of Law - Birmingham campuses and University College Birmingham are both a 20-minute walk, while the University of Birmingham (30 min bus) is slightly further but also accessible. The apartment also offers unmatched transport connectivity with bus, tram, and train stations nearby, putting Birmingham at your fingertips. Aston University Stop (2 min walk), Bagot Street (5 min walk) are the nearest bus stops, St Chads (12 min walk) and Bull Street (14 min walk) are where you can take the West Midlands Metro. If you want to travel far, Birmingham Snow Hill train station is a 14-minute walk, and the Birmingham Airport is a 20-minute car drive. Staniforth House Reviews
Staniforth House is reviewed by 118 students on StudentCrowd and has a grade of 4.28 out of 5, meaning it is the top 7 best-rated student housing in Birmingham on the website. It is highly praised for its central location close to Aston and BCU, as well as the city centre. In addition, its excellent social space, high-speed internet, and friendly staff are also widely recognised.

Lucas Studios is a modern student accommodation in Birmingham that is ideally situated close to top universities. Located at Corporation Street, B4 7DP, Lucas Studios Birmingham is right opposite Aston University (5 minutes walk) and a 15-minute walk from Birmingham City University. The Birmingham city centre is only a short walk for 15 minutes, offering easy access to countless shops, restaurants, bars, and gyms. You will also benefit from a stylish social space, fast Internet, on-site laundry, communal lounge, bike storage, CCTV, and more on-site amenities. Everything at Lucus Studios is included in the rent, so you'll live here without any hassle.
 
Features
Lucas Studios Birmingham offers a range of spacious and modern studio rooms, each with private kitchen and bathroom facilities, and many even have a private terrace or a balcony where you can relax and have fun. Each room at Lucas Studios is fully furnished with students in mind, including a small double bed, study desk and chair, and ample storage. The kitchenette is well-fitted with fridge/freezer, induction hob and sink, ensuite bathroom, small double bed, study desk and chair, and ample storage. Students will find all the essentials ready in your room and can quickly settle down.
 
Everything at Lucas Studios is included in the all-inclusive rent, so students do not need to pay any extra bills and enjoy free access to all amenities. Up to 80Mbps* Internet will keep you connected in the building, the communal lounge, communal TV, and roof terrace provide stylish places to socialise with friends. There are also on-site laundry facilities, bike storage, and recycling, designed to offer more convenience and make your student life easier.
 
Location and What's Hot? 
Living at Universal Student Living Lucas Studios means a short 15-minute walk to the buzzing city centre and the best local amenities. Tesco Express is only a 4-minute walk where you can buy groceries and cook a storm in your private kitchen. Of course, there are also a lot of places to go within walking distance if you're not in the mood for cooking. From BRGRI Birmingham to african restaurant, and Rio's Piri Piri, you can choose from various easy food to take away or delicate restaurants to enjoy delicate cuisines. If you're looking for nightlife, The Bull, Gunmakers Arms, Sacks Of Potatoes, and The Gosta Green are all within a 10-minute walk from Lucas Studios. Also, popular attractions such as 
Thinktank Birmingham Science Museum (17 min walk) and the Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery (21 min walk) are also easily accessible.
 
Transport
Besides being within walking distance to Aston University and BCU, Lucas Studios accommodation boasts convenient transportation links. The University College Birmingham is a 16-minute bus ride away, and the University of Birmingham is a 35-minute bus ride away. The Aston University bus stop is just downstairs, providing quick access to all parts of the city. In addition, during the holiday, you can take a 15-minute bus ride to Birmingham Snow Hill train station, which is the portal to other cities in the UK. Birmingham also has its own airport, located only a 20-minute car drive or 35 minutes by train.
 
Security & Services
Lucas Studios has on-site management, 24-hour CCTV, and electronic key card entry systems to ensure your living is hassle-free. Choose Lucas Studios Birmingham to have fun and make the most of your time at university.
